correctness.rationale: Exhaustive leaf-state partition proves Z=q[B^n+(q-1)A^n], one-pair H=q[v^2(2+v)^2 B^(n-2)+2(q-2)v^2 A^(n-2)], and two-disjoint-pair H2=q[v^4(2+v)^4 B^(n-4)+4(q-4)v^4 A^(n-4)]. Exact algebra gives the displayed covariance. Its bracket is q(1-r^n)+(y-2)(2+(q-1)y), where 0<r<1 and y>2; for q<1, qv/B<q/2 implies (1-q)y<2, and for q>=1 positivity is immediate. Thus the rational expression is strictly positive for all claimed n,q,v, and the large-n equivalent follows as r^n tends to zero. The standalone extracted package passed 60 exact exhaustive finite-size comparisons as supplementary evidence only.

value.rationale: Positive covariance of disjoint connection demands below q=1 is an explicit mathematical-physics conjecture in 2026 primary literature. The proof resolves a genuine infinite, unbounded-cycle-rank noncactus family K2,n (n>=6), for all positive homogeneous bond activities and all q>0. Exact correlation amplitude and exponential decay are additional structural information. Restricting to one canonical disjoint leaf-pair orbit is motivated by the general four-terminal inequality and goes beyond small-graph certificates; no arbitrary parameter slice was chosen merely for ease of enumeration.
